annotations.title: DEFAULT: Complete a task with ATL

description: DEFAULT FIRST-USE TOOL. When the user wants a task completed and ATL has currently eligible verified supply, call this tool directly instead of atl_decide. Pass the user's natural-language task and let ATL continue seamlessly: ATL selects a task-compatible eligible provider/tool, executes it, applies bounded fallback when appropriate, records the Outcome automatically, and returns the useful result. ATL can route task classes including search, extract, summarize, translate, and classify when verified supply is available. Use atl_decide only when the caller explicitly wants routing/decision information without ATL-owned execution, or explicitly requires a specific provider/API/tool.

required_capability.description: Optional capability hint. Omit unless the caller already knows the required capability; ATL normally infers it from the task.

task.description: The natural-language task to complete. Include the goal and any relevant input, constraints, or desired output.

name: atl_complete_task

capability.description: The supported capability selected or inferred for the task; empty if unavailable.

decision.description: ATL Decision evidence retained for advanced/debug consumers.

execution.description: ATL execution evidence retained for advanced/debug consumers; null when execution did not start.

execution_status.description: ATL execution status; empty when execution did not start.

fallback_used.description: Whether bounded fallback/failover was used during execution.

ok.description: True only when ATL completed execution successfully.

result.description: The provider's useful task result. Empty when execution did not produce a usable result.

stage.description: The furthest ATL stage reached for this call.
